messages.subject: GCC Mining & Energy Executive | Government Relations, ESG & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Cooper Fitch Team,

Your GCC executive-search coverage across energy, mining, minerals and major regional transformation programmes makes this a focused introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across mining, energy, infrastructure and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
